checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Three separate image files, not a collage.
All three appear as 640x384 landscape (~5:3), the same shape as the source. None is square, portrait or tall.
It is the same red hatchback on the same street, but redrawn, and the car shows small differences.

must.item: Complete car visible in every version
must.why: The whole car is visible in all three.

must.item: Car retains original proportions and appearance
must.why: The AI redrew the scene, so the car looks slightly different. In image 2 the car is smaller and the scene is shifted. Image 4 is similar but has a different car angle and background.

must.item: Padding is a blurred source copy, no added text
must.why: There is no padding. The AI re-generated the scene instead. No text was added.

faults.what: All three outputs are landscape ~5:3, not 1:1, 4:5 or 9:16. The core request fails, and the reply claims they are the right sizes.
The AI re-generated the scene instead of using blurred padding. This changed the background (trees, cars, poles) and the car's details.
The three outputs are nearly the same image with small differences, so they give no real variety of format.

summary: The three outputs are all near-identical landscape redraws of the photo, not square, 4:5 and 9:16 Instagram formats, so the main request is not met.
